## References

<div class="resource-grid">

<div class="resource-card">
### Machine Learning in Epidemiology

**Authors:** Wright et al. (2026)

This article provides the methodological foundation and heart-disease workflow used in Part 2, including the modelling choices and evaluation strategy behind the applied examples in this workshop.

[Read the article](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16352)
</div>

<div class="resource-card">
### Health Metrics and the Spread of Infectious Diseases

**Author:** Federica Gazzelloni

This book connects health metrics, infectious-disease research, machine learning and spatial modelling with R, offering a broader context for the methods used in the workshop.

[Explore the book](https://federicagazzelloni.com/hmsidR/)
</div>

</div>
